cooldown.quote: {{tt|{{ap|180 to 120}}|Starts after wall expires or is destroyed}}

values.meaning: wall duration after completion before disintegrating
values.quote: The wall lasts for 4 seconds after completion, then slowly disintegrates from its starting point.
Taliyah also {{tip|channels}} for 1 second, during which ''Weaver's Wall'' can be recast and she {{tip|sight|reveals}} herself.
values.binNote: No bin field for the channel duration was found in the sheet; only DamageLockoutTime=3 exists, which is a different (longer) duration.

values.meaning: static cooldown lockout when Taliyah takes champion/turret damage
values.quote: ''Weaver's Wall'' is placed on a {{sti|cd|3-second}} {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} upon taking {{tip|champion}} or {{tip|turret}} damage.
values.binNote: DamageLockoutTime = 3 matches the wiki's 3-second static cooldown on taking champion/turret damage.

mechanics.claim: Weaver's Wall deals no damage itself; it knocks aside (airborne) champions hit and creates terrain, and the recast is a dash/destroy with no damage instance.
mechanics.quote: summons a torrent of spiraling rocks that cascades in the target direction, knocking aside champions hit and erecting a wall of terrain in its wake

mechanics.claim: Cooldown does not begin until the wall expires or is destroyed, so the effective time-to-recast in a fight is cooldown value plus wall lifetime.
mechanics.quote: {{tt|{{ap|180 to 120}}|Starts after wall expires or is destroyed}}

mechanics.claim: The initial cast counts as an ability activation for on-cast effects (e.g. Spellblade), but the two recasts do not.
mechanics.quote: The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: Wind Wall and Blade Whirl block further wall formation and stun Taliyah for 0.25 seconds if she is surfing during the collision, interrupting the surf.
mechanics.quote: If '''Taliyah''' is surfing during the collision, she immediately becomes {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, interrupting the surf.
